2. Queens may not touch, including diagonally. Thus queens in consecutive rows cannot occupy columns differing by 1. Queens separated by more than one row MAY share a long diagonal; this is not the ordinary chess N-queens diagonal rule.
3. The board has exactly one valid solution.

{"board_id":"panel-7-50","columns_by_row":[INTEGER_COLUMN_FOR_ROW_1,...,INTEGER_COLUMN_FOR_ROW_N]}

Board ID: panel-7-50
N: 7
